title: Removal of the Oil Filter Housing Firewall Panel and Engine Harness Clearance Check
abstract: Removal of the oil filter housing firewall panel, with the engine harness clearance check that must be recorded before and after, used for filter access and for the rolled edge panel installation.

sections.purpose: This task removes the firewall panel at the oil filter housing and records the engine harness clearance at the panel edge, which is the measurement that governs whether the harness must be re-clipped.
sections.job_setup_note: The engine must be cool and the oil system unpressurised. Record which latch position the panel was fitted in before you release it: on the earlier panel standard two positions are permitted and the inboard one puts the panel edge onto the harness route. That information is needed by engineering if any chafing is found.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the engine is cool and that the oil system is not pressurised. WARNING: ENGINE OIL AND ITS VAPOUR ARE HARMFUL. WEAR GLOVES AND EYE PROTECTION AND DO NOT WORK UNDER THE HOUSING WITH THE COWL PARTLY SUPPORTED. 2. Open the fan cowl and remove the pylon lower access panel to reach zones 431, 421 and 413. 3. Record which latch position the panel is fitted in. 4. Measure and record the clearance between the panel edge and the engine harness at three positions. 5. Do a detailed visual inspection of the harness over the full length that crosses the panel and record any chafing. CAUTION: IF THE HARNESS SHIELD IS BREACHED, STOP AND REPORT IT. DO NOT REFIT THE PANEL OVER A DAMAGED HARNESS EVEN TEMPORARILY. 6. Remove the cowl latch at FIN 227EO and put it in the parts tray. 7. Remove the seal at FIN 14EO and discard it. 8. Remove the six panel fasteners and the washers AES837153-84 in the reverse of the torque sequence. 9. Support the panel FJD382676-90 and lower it clear. 10. Inspect the panel sealing face and the housing land for heat marking and for distortion. 11. Cap the oil filter housing port if the filter is to be removed in the same visit. 12. Compare the installation with drawings D79201225675 and D79201232627 and report any difference.
sections.close_out: Put the panel on a clean surface with the sealing face protected. Cover the housing aperture if the aircraft is to be left overnight. Record the latch position, the three clearance readings and any chafing finding on the maintenance record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The alternate latch position exists pre MOD-155040 only.

safety_precautions: Wear gloves and eye protection when handling engine oil.
Do not work under the housing with the cowl partly supported.
Do not refit the panel over a damaged harness.
